ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >85% of surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized in scars and markings creating a high local contrast but low global ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-intensity white circular blobs (rosettes) concentrated in the lower left quadrant; linear white filaments on the right lobe; a larger contiguous white/grey patch at the far right distal tip (coordinate extreme right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; depth estimated at 1/5th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude of peaks varies from 2-10 pixels relative to local baseline; texture is jagged with no repeating uniform intervals.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curves on the leading edges (lower boundaries) tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters, likely barnacle attachment sites, densely grouped in the lower mid-left lobe and scattered across the central right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned linear white pixel disruptions; visible as diagonal 'rake marks' on the upper right lobe and horizontal scratches near the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and rake marks visible across both lobes; significant irregular white pigmentation/scarring at the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific constellation of 4-5 high-intensity circular white spots forming a localized cluster in the lower center-left region.
